title: Jonah Flees From the Lord

questions.question: To which city did the word of the Lord command Jonah to go and call out against?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:2 (ESV): "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and call out against it,"

questions.question: Instead of obeying, to which city did Jonah flee?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:3 (ESV): "But Jonah rose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord."

questions.question: From which port did Jonah sail?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:3 (ESV): "He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish."

questions.question: What did the Lord hurl upon the sea to stop Jonah?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:4 (ESV): "But the Lord hurled a great wind upon the sea,"

questions.question: What was Jonah doing while the mariners were afraid?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:5 (ESV): "But Jonah had gone down into the inner part of the ship and had lain down and was fast asleep."

questions.question: What did the captain say to Jonah when he found him sleeping?
options: What do you mean, you sleeper? Arise, call out to your god!
Wake up and help us row!
Why have you brought this evil upon us?
questions.correctAnswer: What do you mean, you sleeper? Arise, call out to your god!
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:6 (ESV): "What do you mean, you sleeper? Arise, call out to your god!"

questions.question: How did the sailors determine who was responsible for the evil upon them?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:7 (ESV): "So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah."

questions.question: How did Jonah identify himself to the sailors?
options: A Hebrew who fears the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: A Hebrew who fears the Lord
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:9 (ESV): "I am a Hebrew, and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land."

questions.question: What did Jonah tell the sailors to do to calm the sea?
options: Pick me up and hurl me into the sea
questions.correctAnswer: Pick me up and hurl me into the sea
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:12 (ESV): "Pick me up and hurl me into the sea; then the sea will quiet down for you,"

questions.question: After throwing Jonah overboard, what did the men do?
options: Feared the Lord exceedingly and offered a sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: Feared the Lord exceedingly and offered a sacrifice
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:16 (ESV): "Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows."

questions.question: What did the Lord appoint to swallow up Jonah?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:17 (ESV): "And the Lord appointed a great fish to swallow up Jonah."

questions.question: How long was Jonah in the belly of the fish?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:17 (ESV): "and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights."

questions.question: The men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not. Why?
options: For the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them
questions.correctAnswer: For the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:13 (ESV): "but they could not, for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them."

questions.question: Before casting lots, what did the sailors say to one another?
options: Come, let us cast lots, that we may know on whose account this evil has come upon us.
Let us throw the cargo overboard.
Let us pray to our gods.
questions.correctAnswer: Come, let us cast lots, that we may know on whose account this evil has come upon us.
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:7 (ESV): "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know on whose account this evil has come upon us."

questions.question: Jonah told them that he was fleeing from the presence of the Lord. How did they know this?
options: Because the lot fell on him
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:10 (ESV): "For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them."

key_verse_text: And the Lord appointed a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
